t: 罗马皇帝哈德良采纳安东尼努斯·皮乌斯为他的儿子,实际上使他成为他的接班人.
te: Roman emperor Hadrian adopts Antoninus Pius as his son, effectively making him his successor.

dz: 罗马皇帝哈德良因心力衰竭而死于他位于那不勒斯湾(英语:Baiae)的住所;他被安葬在罗马哈德良的墓中,与他已故的妻子维比亚·萨比纳同葬.
de: Emperor Hadrian of Rome dies of heart failure at his residence on the bay of Naples, Baiae; he is buried at Rome in the Tomb of Hadrian beside his late wife, Vibia Sabina.
